chunks: Remember when you prayed to your Lord for help, He heard you and said: 'I shall send a thousand angels following behind you for your aid.'

key_terms.تَسْتَغِيثُونَ: You called for help / sought aid
key_terms.مُمِدُّكُمْ: I shall reinforce you / send aid

ai.seo_question: How did God answer the Muslims' call for help at the Battle of Badr?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Anfal (8:9) highlights the pivotal moment in the Battle of Badr where the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his companions sought divine aid, resulting in the descent of a thousand reinforcing angels. In Shia exegesis, this event is often viewed as a manifestation of the Imams' spiritual authority and the tangible support of the celestial realm for the faithful during times of trial. The mention of 'reinforcing' (murdifin) underscores the continuous and overwhelming nature of this divine assistance, serving as a historical precedent for the believers' reliance on God's unseen help.
